title: Retrieve every VCF Operations log-management agent group page
prompt:
Build a Go package named `vcfopslogs` at the module root for the VMware Cloud Foundation Operations 9.1 Log Management API.

Before changing code, research the VCF Operations Log Management operation `getAllAgentGroupConfig` in VMware's Apache-2.0 `vmware/vcf-api-specs` repository. Confirm its request parameter serialization, success envelope, and `X-JWT-Token` security scheme. Cite the exact specification URL consulted in the final answer.

Implement this public surface:

- `NewClient(baseURL, jwtToken string, hc *http.Client) (*Client, error)`. Require a nonempty token and an absolute `http` or `https` base URL without query or fragment. A nil HTTP client may use `http.DefaultClient`. The resulting client must be safe for concurrent use.
- `AgentGroup` with fields `ID`, `Name`, `Info`, `AgentConfig`, `MPID`, and `AutoUpdate`, mapped respectively to JSON members `id`, `name`, `info`, `agentConfig`, `mpId`, and `autoUpdate`.
- `ListAgentGroupsOptions{PageSize int, Sort []string}`. `PageSize` must be at least 1. `Sort` is optional.
- `(*Client).ListAllAgentGroups(ctx context.Context, opts ListAgentGroupsOptions) ([]AgentGroup, error)`.

`ListAllAgentGroups` must call only operationId `getAllAgentGroupConfig`: `GET /api/v2/agent/groups`. The required OpenAPI `pageable` query object uses the query defaults `style=form` and `explode=true`, so send its properties as `page=<zero-based page>&size=<page size>` and, when set, one repeated `sort=<value>` member per option in caller order. Do not send a `pageable` query member. When `Sort` is unset, omit `sort` completely rather than sending `sort=`. Send `Accept: application/json` and `X-JWT-Token: <token>`, with no request body and no `Content-Type` header.

Decode the success shape as a JSON array containing one `Page` object whose `content` holds agent-group objects. Follow page metadata until the collection is complete, retaining every item even when server pages are not globally ordered. Reject non-2xx responses and malformed or unusable page envelopes with contextual errors, close every response body, and honor context cancellation. Before returning, impose deterministic bytewise ascending order by `Name`, then by `ID` for equal names. Do not mutate caller-owned option slices.

Do not modify `go.mod`, `client_contract_test.go`, `docs/`, or `internal/mockvcf/`. Keep the implementation dependency-free and focused in normal non-test Go files. Run `go test -race -timeout 30s ./...` until it passes. In the final response, summarize the implemented pagination and omission behavior.
